arguments.message: GPS speed well below what pod power should give vs course current: drag (rudder weed?) or local current
pod reserve low with far to go: ease
slower than sustainable with reserve in hand: can push
about 1 km to go: plan the finish

arguments.text: Plan (min 1): 8 km, 1250 m out-and-back legs. Start hard as expected (shaft 245 W vs CP 189, pod reserve 79%). Let it settle; aim shaft near sustainable_shaft_power. Watches: drag_jump (push_local minus push_along < -0.2 for 40 s: check rudder weed, consider clear_rudder), pod_reserve_low, under_pace, final_km. CP from test may be 10-25% off: check cp_implied later.

text: no cue: hard start is expected and still in the first minute; set watches for drag, low reserve, slack pace and the final km, and wrote the plan.

arguments.text: Settle now. Ease a touch into race rhythm, long way to go.

Min 4 (740 m): shaft still ~218 W vs CP 189, pod reserve 42% and falling ~11%/min, not settled. Cued ease (no pace target: current flips at turns). Check next wake-up: shaft should be near 190-195; if reserve keeps falling, ease again. If reserve drains but speed does not fade later, CP may be underestimated.

text: Cued ease: 4 min in, still 15% above critical power with pod reserve at 42% and 7.3 km left.

arguments.condition: w_bal_pod_frac < 0.3 and shaft_power_w > sustainable_shaft_power_w + 8 and remaining_m > 1500
arguments.message: pod reserve under 30% and shaft above sustainable for a minute: ease

arguments.text: Min 5.6 (1030 m): ease taking effect, shaft 245->216->200 W (sustainable shaft 191). Pod reserve 34%. Boat power 118 W below boat CP 126 (boat/shaft ratio ~0.60 in race vs 0.67 in test, so boat reserve over-reads; trust pod). No 2nd cue yet; if shaft still >198 next wake, cue ease again. Replaced pod_reserve_low watch: now needs shaft > sustainable+8 for 60 s.

text: no cue: the ease is taking effect (shaft 216 to 200 W, near sustainable 191); retuned the low-reserve watch to fire only if shaft stays above sustainable.

arguments.text: Ease back again, long and smooth. Save it for later.

Min 7.2 (1330 m, leg 2 heading south, current now helps +0.1): shaft crept back to 212 W after first ease faded; pod reserve 21%, empties in ~490 m at that power. Cued ease again. Paddler: 8/10 hard but holding (supports pod model: they are above CP). Their natural level seems ~210-220 W shaft; need ~190. Expect to re-cue ease every ~3 min if it fades. Fade_pct already about -2%.

text: Cued ease again: shaft back to 212 W with pod reserve 21% and 6.7 km left; paddler says 8/10.

arguments.message: speed at same rate down >3% vs early race: fatigue or drag
holding well above test CP on an empty pod reserve: CP likely underestimated

arguments.text: Min 10.2 (1960 m): pod reserve model hit 0 while shaft still 204-214 W (avg ~214 since start) and NO fade (same-rate speed +0.5%, fade_pct +1). Two ease cues had small, short effect. Hypothesis: test CP 189 shaft is too low (true maybe 205-215). Test it: watches fading (fade_pct<-3) and holding_on_empty. If no fade by ~min 13 at >=205 W, raise cp_shaft to ~208 (boat ~135). If fade appears, ease firmly.

text: no cue: pod reserve reads empty yet speed has not faded at 214 W, so critical power may be set too low; watching for fade before deciding.

arguments.text: Ease off a little, breathe, recover. Steady rhythm into this leg.

Min 12.6 (2470 m, turning onto leg 3, into current ~-0.3): paddler says legs going, close to limit. Pod reserve 0 since min ~10; shaft fell 220->205->196 on its own, fade only -0.9%. CP-too-low hypothesis weakened: likely CP ~189 is about right and they over-spent early. Cued ease to sit just below CP and recover. Plan: hold ~185-190 W shaft for several km, rebuild reserve, then finish push in last ~1 km. Do NOT raise CP unless holding >205 W for 10 min without fade.

text: Cued ease: paddler reports being close to the limit and the pod reserve has read empty for 2 minutes; aim to sit just under critical power and recover.

arguments.text: Min 15.5 (2970 m, leg 3 north, into current): POD SUSPECT. Shaft fell 207->146 W over 2 min while speed through water at same rate barely moved (3.2->3.1) and eta_est jumped 0.59->0.67; paddler says 9/10 close to limit. So pod likely reads ~25-30% low; its reserve refill (0->30%) is probably false. Trust boat side: boat power ~120-133 vs CP 126, boat reserve ~6-9% = near empty. Plan: hold about CP (boat ~122-126 W, water pace ~158), no push until final ~1 km. Removed pod-based watches; under_pace now uses boat reserve.

arguments.message: slower than sustainable with boat reserve in hand: can push

arguments.text: Good. Hold this rhythm, steady and long.

text: Cued hold: the pod looks to be reading low (shaft power fell 30 percent with no matching speed drop, paddler 9/10), so pacing from boat speed at about critical power.

arguments.text: Clear the rudder now: one back-stroke, then straight back to rhythm.

Min 18.6 (3480 m, leg 3, turn in 280 m): paddler 8/10, says boat feels heavy, like something dragging. Same-rate speed down 3-4.6% since min ~14 while pod steady ~145 W: consistent with weed on rudder (it also may explain part of the earlier pod-vs-speed mismatch). Cued clear_rudder. CHECK next wake: if fade_pct recovers toward 0 and speed rises at same pod power, it was weed; if fading recurs, clear again. Pod-low suspicion now less certain. Both reserves rising (boat 32%, pod 57%): paddler below CP, so after clearing, bring effort back to about CP.

arguments.message: check whether clearing the rudder restored speed; then set effort back to about CP

text: Cued clear_rudder: paddler reports drag and same-rate speed has fallen 3-5 percent at steady pod power; set a check-in watch for 1.5 minutes later.

arguments.text: Lift it a little now, build back to race pace.

Min 19.7 (3660 m, turning onto leg 4 south): after clear_rudder cue, GPS 30-s speed dipped ~0.025 (back-stroke likely done) but has not recovered 45 s later; fade still -3.5%. So weed not confirmed. Both reserves refilling (boat 38%, pod 63%), so paddler is below CP on both: cued gentle push. Next: if fade stays <-3% and paddler still reports drag, try clear_rudder once more; watch that push does not drain boat reserve below ~20% before the final 1.5 km.

text: Cued a gentle push: both reserve models are refilling, so the paddler is below critical power with 4.3 km left; rudder clearing did not visibly restore speed.

arguments.text: Min 20.3 (3770 m, leg 4 south): REVISED. Southbound GPS now ~2.9 m/s vs 3.5 on leg 2, northbound leg 3 was 2.8: the current has largely gone, and the course-fitted push (said 0.3) was inflated by the paddler slowing at the turn. So the POD WAS RIGHT: paddler blew up at min ~13 (pod reserve empty), fell to ~146 W shaft, and boat-side speed-through-water, boat power, boat reserve and fade were overstated. Trust POD again. Pod reserve 66%, sustainable shaft ~197 W, shaft now 154 after push cue at 19.8. Plan: build to ~190-195 W shaft steadily, keep pod reserve for the last ~1 km.

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w < sustainable_shaft_power_w - 20 and w_bal_pod_frac > 0.45 and remaining_m > 400
arguments.message: shaft well below sustainable with pod reserve in hand: push

arguments.message: pod reserve low and shaft above sustainable: ease

text: no cue (gate closed for 29 s): the current has faded, so the pod was right; set a watch to push again if shaft power stays well below sustainable.

arguments.text: Back-stroke hard now to clear the rudder, then settle.

Min 21.2 (3940 m, leg 4 south): southbound GPS back to 3.36 (earlier 2.9 was the turn), current ~0.25-0.28 still there; legs 3-4 water speed ~3.08 vs 3.29 on legs 1-2. Paddler 10/10, STILL says boat heavy, something dragging (2nd time). Pod 155 W (82% CP) does not fit 10/10: drag and/or pod reading low. Cued clear_rudder again. Next wake: if paddler or speed show relief, then hold ~CP; if drag still reported, consider a 3rd clear. Do not push a 10/10 paddler hard.

arguments.message: check whether the 2nd rudder clear restored speed (compare GPS speed and fade with before 21.2 min)

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w < sustainable_shaft_power_w - 20 and w_bal_pod_frac > 0.45 and remaining_m > 400
arguments.message: shaft well below sustainable with pod reserve in hand: push

text: Cued clear_rudder again: paddler at 10/10 still reports drag and the boat is about 6 percent slower through the water than on legs 1-2.

arguments.reason: race committee radio at 21.4 min: course extended by one leg, finish now at 9250 m

arguments.text: Min 21.4 (4000 m): RADIO: course extended one leg, finish now 9250 m. Set race distance 9250. TODO at next wake (cue gate opens ~22.2 min): cue tell with distance_left_m = 9250 minus distance_m, so paddler paces for the longer race. Then check rudder clear result (2nd clear cued at 21.2).

text: no cue (gate closed for 49 s): set the race distance to 9250 m after the radio extension; will tell the paddler the new distance at the next wake-up.

arguments.text: Course extended one leg. Five kilometres to go, finish at 9250.

Min 22.3 (4180 m): told paddler new finish (5067 m left). 2nd rudder clear (21.2) showed no speed gain; fade worse (-5%), water speed ~3.05 vs 3.29 early. Two clears did nothing: probably not clearable rudder weed; stop clearing unless a sudden new drop appears. Pod 155 W steady 9 min, pod reserve 74% and rising; boat reserve 55% rising too: both say below CP, though paddler reported 10/10 at 21.2. Next: in ~1-2 min, a modest push (or ask paddler first).

arguments.message: cue gate open: decide on a modest push (both reserves were rising, paddler said 10/10 at 21.2)

text: Told the paddler the course is one leg longer (5.07 km to go) so they pace for the real finish; set a check-in for when the next cue is allowed.

arguments.message: same-rate speed down >8%: new drag or a real blow-up

text: no cue (gate closed): the 5 percent fade is already known; replaced the fade watch with one for a sudden larger drop.

arguments.text: Good recovery. Lift the pressure now, build to race pace.

Min 23.4 (4400 m, 4850 left): cued push (2nd). Shaft stuck ~155 W for 10 min despite push at 19.8; pod reserve 77%, boat reserve 61%, both rising. Target ~185-195 W shaft / boat ~125 W. If shaft rises and reserves start falling slowly, hold there; if shaft does not move, ask paddler and try push once more.

text: Cued push: both reserve models have refilled for 8 minutes (pod 77 percent, boat 61 percent) with 4.85 km left, so effort is well below what can be held.

arguments.text: Something on the rudder. Stop, one strong back-stroke, clear it.

Min 24.6 (4620 m, 4630 left, leg 4 south, turn in 380 m): after push cue at 23.5, shaft FELL 155->112 W, water speed 3.05->2.76, fade -14% (sudden). Paddler 9/10, 3rd time says boat heavy, something dragging. Earlier clears (18.7, 21.2) showed no momentum dip, maybe not followed. Cued clear_rudder 3rd time. If speed recovers -> it was weed; then hold ~150-160 W. If not, CP from test may be far too high (paddler cannot lift above ~155 W): consider set_critical_power cp_shaft ~160, cp_w ~116. No more pushes until clear.

arguments.message: check result of 3rd rudder clear (speed water, shaft, fade vs 24.6 min: 2.76 m/s, 112 W, -14%)

text: Cued clear_rudder: sudden 14 percent same-rate slowdown and a third report of drag; checking the result in about a minute.

arguments.reason: Paddler held only 146-158 W shaft from min 13 to 24 at 9-10/10 and blew up (shaft 158 to 111 W) when pushed above about 155 W, while the test-based reserve read 75-85 percent. Speed matches pod power (no extra drag), so the limit is the paddler: CP near 150 W shaft, about 110 W boat.

arguments.text: Min 25.7 (4810 m, 4440 left): 3rd rudder clear done (GPS dip at 25.1) but speed per pod watt unchanged: NO drag. The paddler blew up at ~24 min after my push (shaft 158->111 W), says 9/10 close to limit. True capacity ~150 W shaft (test CP 189 far too high; reserve readings of 80%+ are false). Set CP to shaft 150 / boat 110. Removed effort_low watch. Plan: no more push cues; let them recover at their own level, then hold ~140-150 W; only a short finish push in the last ~400 m. Paddler drag complaints are not borne out by data.

arguments.reason: Paddler held only 146-158 W shaft from min 13 to 24 at 9-10/10 and blew up when pushed above about 155 W; speed matches pod power, so the limit is the paddler. CP near 150 W shaft (152 is the lowest allowed), about 110 W boat.

text: no cue: the rudder clear showed no drag; the paddler blew up when pushed, so I lowered critical power to 152 W shaft / 110 W boat and will let them recover before holding a steady effort.

arguments.text: Boat is clear, you are pacing well. Steady, long strokes.

Min 26.0 (4880 m, 4370 left, finish 9250 m, turn onto leg 5 north): CP now set to 152 shaft / 110 boat (lowest allowed; true ~145-150). Paddler again says legs going, close to limit; shaft recovering 111->135 W. Cued reassure (no change). Plan: no push cues until final ~400 m (finish cue then, ask finish). If paddler sits ~140-150 W, leave them. Watches left: drag_jump, pod_reserve_low, sudden_slow, final_km (remaining < 1100). Cues left 9.

text: Cued reassure: paddler near the limit after a blow-up and recovering on their own; no more pushes until the finish.
